findings.title: CMEK key granted to Data Fusion has no IAM binding for the Data Fusion service agent
findings.explanation: The example wires crypto_key_reference = google_kms_crypto_key.datafusion.id into the module, but Data Fusion CMEK requires the Data Fusion service agent (service-<PROJECT_NUMBER>@gcp-sa-datafusion.iam.gserviceaccount.com) to hold roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on that key *before* the instance is created. No such IAM binding exists anywhere in the example, so `terraform apply` will fail at instance-creation time with a permission-denied error from the Data Fusion API.
findings.remediation: Add a google_project_service_identity (google-beta) for api_service = "datafusion.googleapis.com" to obtain the service agent deterministically, then grant it access via google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member, and make the Data Fusion module depend on that binding.

findings.title: Module exposes CMEK input but never outputs p4_service_account needed to complete the KMS grant
findings.explanation: google_data_fusion_instance exports a computed p4_service_account attribute (the Data Fusion service agent email) specifically so callers can grant it CryptoKey Encrypter/Decrypter on their CMEK key. The module accepts crypto_key_reference but does not surface this attribute, forcing every consumer to re-derive the service agent email themselves (e.g. via google_project_service_identity) instead of reading it off the module. Ties into HOLDEN_BP_001.
findings.remediation: Add an output for p4_service_account (and ideally service_endpoint/api_endpoint, see HOLDEN_BP_004) so consumers can wire up IAM without recomputing the service agent identity.

findings.title: Instance tier is hardcoded to BASIC, so the module can never provision an ENTERPRISE (HA/higher-throughput) instance
findings.explanation: type = "BASIC" is a literal, not a variable. BASIC is the lowest Data Fusion tier (no autoscaling, lower pipeline concurrency). Any consumer needing ENTERPRISE for production throughput/HA must fork or wrap this module rather than pass a value in.
findings.remediation: Promote type to a variable (default "BASIC" to preserve current behavior) with a validation restricting it to the values Data Fusion supports (BASIC, ENTERPRISE, DEVELOPER).

findings.title: Module only outputs id; service_endpoint and api_endpoint are dropped
findings.explanation: Consumers need service_endpoint (Data Fusion UI/REST) and api_endpoint to actually reach the instance or automate pipeline deployment. Today they have to reference the module's internal resource address directly, which defeats the purpose of the module boundary.
findings.remediation: Add outputs for service_endpoint and api_endpoint alongside id.

findings.title: KMS key rotation_period is set to ~27.8 hours, unusually frequent for a CMEK key
findings.explanation: rotation_period = "100000s" is about 27.8 hours. Typical CMEK rotation is 90 days (7776000s); rotating every day adds key-version churn and Cloud KMS operation cost with no compensating benefit for an example/dev key. This may be an unintentional value (looks like a round number chosen without the unit in mind).
findings.remediation: Use a standard rotation period such as 7776000s (90 days), or drop rotation_period entirely and rotate manually if this is meant purely as a driving example.
